_comment: Machine-readable companion to STYLE-GUIDE.md. The social-creative-designer skill reads this at runtime so it holds no brand specifics of its own. Numbers under layout_calibration are measured off social/_references/1.png, 2.png, 3.png — update them here (not in the skill) when the reference set changes.

photography.environment: real stainless-steel working surfaces and trays in an active preparation area
photography.realism: phone-camera realism, minor imperfection welcome, not glossy or over-polished
photography.hands: hands and forearms only, in black nitrile gloves
photography.props: rosemary, citrus or peppers used sparingly as freshness cues
photography.color_mood: deep natural red meat tones against cool steel grey
avoid: any text, lettering, numerals or signage
letterboxing, blank borders or empty white bands
gloves in any colour other than black
photography.negative_prompt: text, lettering, typography, watermark, logo, signage, faces, people, restaurant plating, garnish styling, warm candlelight, heavy vignette, blurred background bokeh, white border, letterbox bars

headline.surface: torn white paper, soft drop shadow
headline.note: sits beside the product, never a full-width strip across the top edge

signature_devices: torn white paper label carrying bold red Arabic text, tilted ~-3 degrees
short curved white hand-drawn arrow from the label to the cut it names
green WhatsApp CTA pill, bottom-centre, kept prominent
small corner logo lockup with no backing disc
contact line in small white text straight on the photo, no bar
